headlines.title: Florida rides win over Rebels to No. 8 ranking in AP Top 25; Texas, Georgia, Notre Dame top 3 again - apnews.com
Georgia park mass shooting wounds 11 teens at birthday party
Georgia Marks 33 Years Since Fall of Sokhumi
“Saturday march” in Tbilisi: “Abkhazia is Georgia” and solidarity with Ukraine. Video podcast “Protests in Georgia”
Lithuania to let Belarusians apply for residence permits in Armenia, Georgia

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
A mass shooting at a Georgia park wounded 11 teens at a birthday party. [2]
Georgia marks 33 years since the fall of Sokhumi, and a Saturday march in Tbilisi carried the slogan "Abkhazia is Georgia" and expressed solidarity with Ukraine. [3][4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GEORGIA
The ongoing public demonstrations in Tbilisi linking Abkhazia and Ukraine underscore Georgia's unresolved territorial dispute, while the country maintains a low government travel advisory of Exercise Normal Precautions. [3][4][E1]

KEY RISKS
Georgia's high net energy import dependency of 78% exposes it to potential energy supply shocks. [E3]
Georgia's link to 21 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations could deter foreign investment and complicate financial transactions. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Kalshi market, "Georgian parliamentary election winner?: Georgian Dream – Democratic Georgia", priced Yes at 74% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Oct 31, 2029. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the investigation into the Georgia park mass shooting that wounded 11 teens remains unresolved. [2]
It is unclear whether the Kalshi market prediction of a 74% probability that Georgian Dream – Democratic Georgia wins the next parliamentary election will materialize by the market's close on Oct 31, 2029. [E4]
